about: Owner rule D25 (the reference-date Fandom TibiaWiki decides; otherwise Canary is kept) applied to the Canary/CrystalServer conflicts of the quest transcriptions. Differences are summarised in our own words; no wiki or journal text is copied. Basis: equivalent (same behaviour), implementation detail (storage naming), wording (spelling or grammar), wiki (the cited revision decides), wiki silent (Canary kept).
